content_sections.heading: About PCIM&H
content_sections.text: The Pharmacopoeia Commission for Indian Medicine & Homoeopathy (PCIM&H) is a government commission in Ghaziabad. Under this notice, people for its posts are engaged through M/s JMJ Enterprises Solutions Ltd, an outsourcing agency whose corporate office is at C-37, Ground Floor, East of Kailash, New Delhi-110065.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are 20 posts in total. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The application format asks for each candidate's age as on 25/10/2026. In the case of meritorious candidates, the age limit and the qualification criteria may be relaxed at the discretion of PCIM&H. Essential: Knowledge of NABL/ISO standards and knowledge of computer applications such as MS Word, MS Excel & Power Point. Desirable: Experience: 05 Years of experience in concerned field from any research Institute. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in ASU&H drugs analysis, including handling instruments like HPTLC/GC/ICP OES etc., and with publications in SCI Indexing Journals and article writing skills. Essential: 02 years' experience in any research institute. Essential: Knowledge of computer applications such as MS Word, MS Excel & Power Point. Essential: 2 years' experience in microbial Drug Testing /Microbial Research. Essential: Should have good communication, typing speed, capable in taking dictation, writing ability and interpersonal skills. Essential: Knowledge of computer applications such as MS Word, MS Excel & Power Point. Essential: Possession of valid driving license for motor cars. Essential: 5 years' experience of driving a government vehicle. Essential: 8th Passed (no other requirement is printed for this post). Should have knowledge of Hindi or English and local language. Good physique and personality, fulfilling requirements of physical standards and medical fitness as per PSARA Act and Rules. Minimum Experience 3 years. Should have knowledge of Security related matters, industrial safety and allied functions. Preference will be given to Ex-servicemen from Military and para military forces or a person who has served in police and Home Guards. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification_education: M.Sc. in Chemistry/ M. Pharm. in Pharmaceutical Analysis/Quality Control & Assurance/Pharmaceutical Chemistry from recognized University, and Ph.D. in concerned subject from recognized University

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a contractual basis, and no claim for continuance or regular appointment will be entertained. The period of engagement will be initially for one year or until the outsourcing agency's tenure ends, whichever is earlier, based on performance in the interview. Applicable deductions for ESI, PF and taxes will be made as per rules.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PCIM&H Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 20 posts: Project Consultant (Chemistry) 01, Pharmacopoeial Associate (Chemistry) 01, Pharmacopoeial Associate (Microbiology) 01, Office Assistant 04, Driver 01, MTS (Mali) 04 and MTS (Security) 08.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for PCIM&H Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 October 2026. Applications received after that date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the PCIM&H Office Assistant and MTS posts?
faq.answer: Office Assistant needs Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University, plus communication, typing, dictation and computer skills. MTS (Mali) needs 8th Passed, and MTS (Security) needs Minimum 10th pass with 3 years' experience and the other conditions listed for that post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for PCIM&H Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit should not exceed 64 years for Project Consultant (Chemistry), Driver and MTS (Security). It should not exceed 35 years for the two Pharmacopoeial Associate posts, and 30 years for Office Assistant and MTS (Mali), in case of fresh engagement. The form asks for age as on 25/10/2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary in PCIM&H Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration is Rs. 50,000/- for Project Consultant (Chemistry) and Rs. 32,000/- for each Pharmacopoeial Associate post. It is Rs 26,208/- for Office Assistant and Driver, and Rs 24,810/- for MTS (Mali) and MTS (Security). ESI, PF and taxes are deducted as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for PCIM&H Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application format with a self-attested photo. Then email it with your self-attested mark sheets, certificates, testimonials, experience certificates and signed biodata to [email protected] by 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for PCIM&H Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are told by email to attend an interview, with the interview date. Engagement is based on performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the PCIM&H job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, through M/s JMJ Enterprises Solutions Ltd. It lasts initially for one year or until the outsourcing agency's tenure ends, whichever is earlier, and no claim for continuance or regular appointment will be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the PCIM&H interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets preference for the PCIM&H MTS (Security) post?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to Ex-servicemen from Military and para military forces, or a person who has served in police and Home Guards.
